{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint ORR may not capture IT injection effect on non-target lesions",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1).",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is to determine ORR with vidutolimod in combination with cemiplimab, but the exploratory objectives emphasize effects on injected and noninjected target lesions. RECIST v1.1 may not fully capture responses in non-target lesions or lesions not selected as target lesions, potentially underestimating the treatment effect of intratumoral therapy.",
      "fix": "Consider using a modified response criteria that includes assessment of all injected and noninjected lesions, or specify that ORR is based on target lesions only and justify."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criteria for CSCC allow non-measurable disease but primary endpoint requires measurable disease",
      "quote": "CSCC subjects without radiographically measurable disease are not excluded if there is at least 1 lesion ≥ 10 mm in at least 1 dimension documented by color photography.",
      "page": 52,
      "section": "3.5",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "This inclusion criterion permits enrollment of subjects without radiographically measurable disease, but the primary endpoint ORR per RECIST v1.1 requires measurable disease. This inconsistency may lead to subjects who cannot be evaluated for the primary endpoint, causing amendments or protocol deviations.",
      "fix": "Clarify that all subjects must have measurable disease per RECIST v1.1, or specify that non-measurable disease subjects are only for exploratory cohorts and not included in primary efficacy analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for TNBC requires prior sacituzumab govitecan for all TNBC patients, which may be overly restrictive",
      "quote": "Patients must have previously received treatment with sacituzumab govitecan (all TNBC patients), with trastuzumab deruxtecan (HER2-low patients) and with PARP inhibitor (for BRCA) patients.",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "3.5",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Requiring prior sacituzumab govitecan for all TNBC patients may be overly restrictive, as some patients may not be candidates for or may not have access to this therapy. This could slow enrollment and limit generalizability.",
      "fix": "Consider allowing patients who are ineligible for sacituzumab govitecan or who have refused it, with documentation."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exclusion criterion for prior immune-mediated AE leading to permanent discontinuation may be ambiguous",
      "quote": "History of immune-mediated AE leading to permanent discontinuation due to prior PD1–blocking antibody.",
      "page": 55,
      "section": "3.6",
      "category": "amendment_risk",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The term 'immune-mediated AE' is not defined, and it is unclear whether all such AEs or only severe ones are excluded. This ambiguity may lead to inconsistent application and potential amendments.",
      "fix": "Define immune-mediated AE and specify severity grades that lead to exclusion, e.g., Grade 3 or higher."
    },
    {
      "title": "No safety monitoring for intratumoral injection-related complications",
      "quote": "Evaluate the safety and tolerability of vidutolimod administered by IT injection in combination with cemiplimab",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify monitoring for injection-related adverse events such as pain, swelling, ulceration, or systemic effects from intratumoral injection. Given the route of administration, specific safety assessments should be included.",
      "fix": "Add specific monitoring for injection site reactions and systemic inflammatory responses in the Schedule of Activities and safety monitoring plan."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for BCC excludes prior hedgehog inhibitor but does not specify prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy",
      "quote": "have not received prior therapy with a hedgehog pathway inhibitor (vismodegib or sonidegib) or prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "3.5",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The criterion is clear, but it may be overly restrictive for BCC patients who have not received hedgehog inhibitors but have received anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, which is not standard for BCC. This could limit enrollment.",
      "fix": "Consider allowing patients who have received prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy if they are not candidates for hedgehog inhibitors."
    },
    {
      "title": "No upper limit on number of prior lines for CSCC and MCC cohorts",
      "quote": "Cohort A1: Subjects who have not received prior systemic therapy for CSCC and who are not eligible for curative radiation.",
      "page": 52,
      "section": "3.5",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "For cohorts A2 and B2, there is no limit on the number of prior systemic therapies, which may lead to enrollment of heavily pretreated patients with poor performance status, potentially confounding efficacy and safety results.",
      "fix": "Specify a maximum number of prior lines for cohorts A2 and B2, or justify inclusion of heavily pretreated patients."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoint includes 'Golgi gene expression signature' which is not defined",
      "quote": "tumor inflammatory gene expression (including IFN-gamma, Golgi gene expression signature).",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The term 'Golgi gene expression signature' is not defined or referenced, making it ambiguous and difficult to implement consistently.",
      "fix": "Define the Golgi gene expression signature or provide a reference to a specific gene set."
    }
  ]
}
